purpose: Test whether the five P2E16B fixed-step Reference retry cases are recoverable by increasing only the nonlinear iteration budget, with physics, dt, tolerances and backtracking unchanged.
primary_endpoint: first max_iterations value producing a valid Reference solve for each case, if any

interpretation_rules.recovered: A case is recovered if a budget >16 yields a valid Reference solve under otherwise identical controls.
interpretation_rules.not_recovered: No tested budget through 64 yields a valid solve.
interpretation_rules.primary_counts: P2E16B counts remain unchanged regardless of outcome.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute the frozen 25-solve Reference-only iteration-budget matrix.
